instruction.text: Read the sentence and choose the response that uses verbal irony.

hint.text:
Verbal irony is saying one thing when you actually mean the opposite.

Callie’s car broke down in the middle of the road. 'Oh, great' she sighed.

atoms.a: After leaving the house, you realise you forgot your keys and the door is locked.
You are looking at your younger brother’s messy bedroom.
Your mum made an incredible cake. You ate 4 slices in one sitting.
You’re staying in the biggest suite in a hotel.

instruction.text: Look at the picture and choose the response that uses verbal irony.

b: ++We seem to be lost. Well, this is just fantastic.

instruction.text: Do these sentences use verbal irony? Click on the correct category.

atoms.a: My car broke down, I was stuck on the side of the road for 7 hours and missed my sister’s wedding. I had the time of my life!
Tony doesn’t feel comfortable in a messy flat. His place is always tidy.
Oh yeah, running up twelve flights of stairs after eating cheesecake sounds really fun.
Oh no, nobody likes to eat Halloween sweets.
